machine.opis: Wentylator wyciągowy, wirnik między łożyskami, napęd przez sprzęgło

state.units: vibration velocity mm/s RMS; phase in degrees
state.technician_notes: Drgania rosną stopniowo od ok. 6 miesięcy. Wentylator pracuje w zapylonym powietrzu, łopatek nie czyszczono od roku.

unbalance.instructions: Use the 1x, 2x, 3x spectra in `bearings`, the ratios and H–V phase difference in `computed_indicators`, the phase between bearings in `phase_between_bearings`, the ISO 20816-3 zone and `technician_notes`. Does the vibration pattern indicate rotor unbalance?

criteria.true: Dominant radial 1x (most of overall), low harmonics, low axial, H–V phase difference near 90 deg, H/V ratio roughly 1–3.
criteria.false: Pattern not consistent with unbalance or better explained by another fault.

unbalance_type.instructions: Use the 1x, 2x, 3x spectra in `bearings`, the ratios and H–V phase difference in `computed_indicators`, the phase between bearings in `phase_between_bearings`, the ISO 20816-3 zone and `technician_notes`. Which type of unbalance best matches the phase relationship between the bearings?

criteria.static: Bearings vibrate in phase (DE–NDE phase difference near 0 deg in the same direction).
criteria.couple: Bearings vibrate in antiphase (DE–NDE phase difference near 180 deg).
criteria.dynamic: Combination of static and couple: DE–NDE phase difference clearly between 0 and 180 deg.
criteria.overhung: Overhung rotor: high axial 1x in phase at both bearings, radial phase pattern irregular.

alt_misalignment.instructions: Use the 1x, 2x, 3x spectra in `bearings`, the ratios and H–V phase difference in `computed_indicators`, the phase between bearings in `phase_between_bearings`, the ISO 20816-3 zone and `technician_notes`. Is misalignment a more likely explanation (high 2x relative to 1x, high axial, ~180 deg across the coupling)?

alt_looseness_or_weakness.instructions: Use the 1x, 2x, 3x spectra in `bearings`, the ratios and H–V phase difference in `computed_indicators`, the phase between bearings in `phase_between_bearings`, the ISO 20816-3 zone and `technician_notes`. Is mechanical looseness or structural weakness more likely (very high H/V ratio above ~3, H–V phase near 0 or 180 deg, many harmonics)?

alt_resonance.instructions: Use the 1x, 2x, 3x spectra in `bearings`, the ratios and H–V phase difference in `computed_indicators`, the phase between bearings in `phase_between_bearings`, the ISO 20816-3 zone and `technician_notes`. Is a structural resonance near running speed a plausible amplifier (strongly directional 1x, unstable phase, very high H/V ratio)?

action.instructions: Use the 1x, 2x, 3x spectra in `bearings`, the ratios and H–V phase difference in `computed_indicators`, the phase between bearings in `phase_between_bearings`, the ISO 20816-3 zone and `technician_notes`. What is the most appropriate next action?

criteria.no_action: Vibration acceptable (zone A/B) and no progressing trend.
criteria.clean_rotor_then_check: Gradual rise with likely material build-up or wear on the rotor; clean first, then re-measure before balancing.
criteria.balance_single_plane: Static unbalance on a narrow rotor; balance in one plane.
criteria.balance_two_planes: Dynamic or couple unbalance; balance in two planes.
criteria.investigate_other_cause: Pattern points to another fault; diagnose before balancing.
